body: **Foco:** Verbo-chave: make.
**Verbos:** infer.
**Expressões:** On the grounds that….
**Pronúncia:** Pausas e ritmo.
**22 palavras novas** (negócios).
**Texto do dia:** conto e trecho de peça.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo usar make em contextos C1 (make up, make out, make do, make for, make off with, make a case) num conto, e usar infer e On the grounds that…

body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Story: The Missing Ledger
paras: Marta could not **make out** the handwriting, but she **inferred** that the entries had been changed. She **made a case** to the board **on the grounds that** the totals did not add up. Nobody wanted to **make a fuss**.

The accountant had **made off with** the original ledger. Without it, they had to **make do** with copies. In the end, the evidence **made for** a clear conclusion: someone had **made up** the figures.

items.q: The accountant took the original ledger.

Significado

blocks.body: **on the grounds that** = com base no fato de que (justificativa formal). **infer** = deduzir a partir de indícios.

items.s: She could not make ___ the handwriting. (out)
They had to make ___ with copies. (do)
She made a case ___ the grounds that totals did not add up. (on)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.pt: A Marta conseguiu ler a caligrafia?

body: **On the grounds that…** — Com base no fato de que…
**Make a fuss.** — Fazer alarde.
**Make ends meet.** — Pagar as contas.
**Make waves.** — Causar polêmica.
**Make a killing.** — Ganhar uma fortuna.
**Make headway.** — Progredir.
**Make light of.** — Minimizar.
**Make sense of.** — Entender o sentido de.
**Could Marta read the handwriting?** — A Marta conseguiu ler a caligrafia?
**Why did she make a case to the board?** — Por que ela apresentou o caso ao conselho?
**On the grounds that the totals did not add up.** — Com base em que os totais não batiam.

head: Phrasal verb
Significado
Exemplo
rows: I can’t make out the words. — Não consigo distinguir as palavras.
He made up a story. — Ele inventou uma história.
We made do with less. — Nos viramos com menos.
He made off with the cash. — Ele fugiu com o dinheiro.

blocks.title: Story club
lines: A Marta conseguiu ler a caligrafia?
No, she couldn’t make it out, but she inferred the entries were changed.
Não, não conseguiu decifrar, mas inferiu que os lançamentos foram alterados.
Why did she make a case to the board?
Por que ela apresentou o caso ao conselho?
On the grounds that the totals did not add up.
Com base em que os totais não batiam.

items.label: Pausas e ritmo
items.note: Faça pausas curtas entre grupos de sentido (thought groups) e mantenha o ritmo: sílabas fortes em intervalos regulares, fracas comprimidas.
words: In my view, | the plan | is sound.
Having reviewed the data, | we agreed.

prompts.model: I can’t make out his words.
She made a case for change.

blocks.task: Write a 7-sentence mystery paragraph using make out, make up, make do, make off with and infer.
blocks.model: Marta could not make out the handwriting, but she inferred that the entries had been changed. She made a case to the board on the grounds that the totals did not add up. The accountant had made off with the original ledger. They had to make do with copies. In the end, it was clear that someone had made up the figures. Nobody was surprised.
checklist: Usei **make out / up / do / off with**

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
